title: Exclusive mutation and frame
contract: Under a disjoint mutable borrow, increment the target and preserve the independent other cell.
scope: Alias flag and values 0..2; admission no alias; abstract two-cell memory.
assumptions: Only admitted inputs within the finite model; outside-assumption probes are recorded separately and are not contract failures.

obligations.claim: Borrow has exclusive access to target.
Target increments by one and other cell is unchanged.

variants.description: Use copy-on-write for the target, preserving declared observations.
